sql:
SELECT
  to_char(date_trunc('month', c.created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS carts_created,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'converted') / COUNT(*), 1) AS overall_conversion_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.converted_at, c.abandoned_at, c.expires_at) - c.created_at <= INTERVAL '1 hour') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_resolved_within_1_hour,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.converted_at, c.abandoned_at, c.expires_at) - c.created_at > INTERVAL '1 hour' AND COALESCE(c.converted_at, c.abandoned_at, c.expires_at) - c.created_at <= INTERVAL '7 days') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_resolved_1_7_days,
  ROUND(CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.converted_at - c.created_at))/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'converted') AS numeric), 1) AS median_days_to_convert
FROM carts c
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
WHERE t.name IN ('Kibblewick','Studio Vrij','Petalcourt Beauty','Marrowby & Vane','Cragsley Outfitters','Ampfeld Elektronik')
  AND c.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', c.created_at)
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', c.created_at)
